Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Regal Adornment Rug, 8' x 10', Burgundy
Colors: Burgundy
Materials: stone
Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Cotton Imported This traditional-style rug features beautiful reds, blues and greens against a tan background. Made of materials designed to resist stains, fading and static, this rug looks vintage but is low maintenance and ideal for a busy room in your home. Classic style with modern materials Machine made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene. Classic, time-tested look with durability for high-traffic areas 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
